schema_discrepancy_resolution.details: HDU 0 is an empty PrimaryHDU (NAXIS=0, 5 header cards) across ALL pointings (including historical P0003). All 293 observation metadata header cards (OBSID, DETECTOR, WCS, TSAMP, HIERARCH) reside in HDU 1 (IMAGE). Previous reporting that metadata was in PRIMARY was an interpretation artifact from raw byte header inspection.

statistical_independence_hierarchy.statistical_limitation: Partitioning 5 pointings into disjoint calibration (P_cal=2) and evaluation (P_eval=3) leaves the evaluation set with G_eval=3 independent pointing clusters, yielding only 10 unique cluster bootstrap multisets. A full multi-pointing expansion (P_eval >= 15-20) remains necessary for asymptotic CI precision.
